fact: The Internet Society Pulse IXP Tracker, drawing on PeeringDB self-reported data, lists the Angola Internet Exchange Point (angonix) in Luanda as active with 23 members, at one physical location, as of June 2026; Pulse says 86% of Angola's 63 active networks are members or customers of members of an IXP.

Portal de TI reports analyst Darwin Costa said Angonix and Angola IXP, Angola's two main exchange points, peaked at 59.5 Gbps and above 11 Gbps in late July 2025, with Microsoft and Meta present at these IXPs.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Angola: Angola-IXP (ANG-IXP), Luanda, and Angonix, Luanda.
Analyst Darwin Costa, interviewed by Portal de T.I., says Angola's active internet exchange points, Angonix and Angola-IXP, are both in Luanda.
